title: SERVICE_REQUEST after authentication is accepted
quote: If the server supports the service (and permits the client to use it), it MUST respond with the following: byte SSH_MSG_SERVICE_ACCEPT
rationale: After successful authentication, SR_AUTH or SR_CONN answered with SERVICE_ACCEPT (v1 D5: Dropbear; OpenSSH UNIMPLEMENTED, Go closes). The RFC does not say whether a second request is permitted. Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D5 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
